nodes.title: About this workflow
widgets_values:
# Pro Upscale (SeedVR2 + Flux)

> ⚠️ **R&D workflow.** Under active development and testing. Not production-ready: expect changes to nodes, defaults and models.

**Engines**
- **SeedVR2 (default):** pre-scale → tile → SeedVR2 7B → optional Flux enhancement → untile.
- **Super Fast:** 4xNomos8kDAT model upscale, then resized to the factor. Flux is not used.

**Controls**
- `Toggle · SeedVR2 Engine` off switches to Super Fast.
- `Toggle · Flux Enhancement` only applies to the SeedVR2 engine.
- `Upscale Factor`: 2 or 4 (the values the app exposes).
- `Flux Creativity`: 10–40 (steps 6–12, denoise 0.10–0.40).

Disabled branches are skipped at run time by lazy **Switch** nodes, so they cost no GPU time.

nodes.title: About this stage
widgets_values:
**Prepare & Tile**

Clamp input size, pre-scale by the upscale factor, split into ~900 px tiles.

nodes.title: About this stage
widgets_values:
**SeedVR2 Upscale**

SeedVR2 7B sharp restores each tile (shortest edge 1024).

nodes.title: About this stage
widgets_values:
**Flux Enhancement (Fluxmania · Nunchaku)**

Low-denoise Flux img2img pass per tile. Creativity sets steps and denoise.

nodes.title: About this stage
widgets_values:
**Reassemble Tiles**

Resize tiles back to the grid size and merge them.

**Super Fast · 4xNomos8kDAT**
